title: Fix pkgconf infinite reinstall after macOS upgrade
body:
- Force source build in reinstall_pkgconf_if_needed! to avoid reusing stale bottle from older macOS version
- Use Version.parse for robust major version extraction in macos_sdk_mismatch detection

Ref: https://github.com/orgs/Homebrew/discussions/7093
